content.text: Section 8 matches the preferred position precisely, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: The renewal mechanics meet the preferred position in full: renewal terms are twelve months (no multi-year auto-renewal), Customer alone may opt out on only thirty days' written notice, Vendor must send a reminder sixty days before renewal (with the opt-out deadline extended if it fails to do so), and § 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and three percent with ninety days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods. The three-year commitment in § 8.1 is an initial term, not an automatic multi-year renewal, so it does not trigger the walk-away parameter. No change required for this rule.
